name: CyberArk
description: Connect your own CyberArk Privileged Access Manager (PVWA) to manage Safes, privileged Accounts, credential retrieval/rotation, Just-In-Time access requests, and Applications, plus review Security Events.

tools.name: connect_cyberark
tools.description: Connect your own CyberArk PVWA vault by saving its base URL and credentials, after checking they actually work.

label.description: Friendly vault label, e.g. 'Acme Production Vault'.
label.title: Label

tools.name: disconnect_cyberark
tools.description: Disconnect a CyberArk vault: deletes only the saved credentials. Nothing in CyberArk itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved CyberArk vault connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected CyberArk vaults.

tools.name: audit_vault
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report for the connected CyberArk vault: Safe count, Account count, and pending access requests.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_safes
tools.description: List Safes in the connected CyberArk vault, optionally filtered by a search string.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

search.description: Optional search string matching Safe name.
search.title: Search

tools.name: get_safe
tools.description: Read one CyberArk Safe in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_safe
tools.description: Create a new Safe in the connected CyberArk vault.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

managing_cpm.description: Optional name of the CPM (Central Policy Manager) that manages password rotation for this Safe.
managing_cpm.title: Managing Cpm

tools.name: list_safe_members
tools.description: List the members (users/groups with access) of a CyberArk Safe.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: add_safe_member
tools.description: Grant a user or group access to a CyberArk Safe.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

member_name.description: User or group name to add as a Safe member.
member_name.title: Member Name

permissions.description: Optional explicit permission flags, e.g. {'UseAccounts': true, 'RetrieveAccounts': true}.
permissions.title: Permissions

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List privileged Accounts in the connected CyberArk vault, optionally filtered by a search string or Safe name.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

search.description: Optional free-text search (matches account name, username, address).
search.title: Search

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read one privileged Account's metadata in full (never the secret itself -- use retrieve_account_password for that).

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Onboard a new privileged Account into a Safe.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

safe_name.description: Safe this account will be stored in.
safe_name.title: Safe Name

secret.description: Initial password/secret value (optional -- CyberArk can also onboard without one for later rotation).
secret.title: Secret

name.description: Optional friendly account name; CyberArk auto-generates one if omitted.
name.title: Name

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing Account (name, address). Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description: Permanently delete a privileged Account from CyberArk. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: retrieve_account_password
tools.description: Retrieve a privileged Account's current password/secret. This exposes real credentials -- use with care.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

reason.description: Reason/ticket-id for this retrieval, required by Safes configured for dual control or strict auditing.
reason.title: Reason

tools.name: verify_account_password
tools.description: Verify a privileged Account's stored password still matches the target system (CyberArk's own reconciliation check).

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: reconcile_account_password
tools.description: Force-reconcile a privileged Account's password using its Safe's configured reconciliation account -- use after a manual out-of-band change desynced the vault.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: change_account_password
tools.description: Rotate a privileged Account's password immediately (CPM-managed or explicit new value). This changes the real credential in the target system.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

new_password.description: Optional explicit new password. Omit to let CyberArk auto-generate one per the account's platform policy.
new_password.title: New Password

tools.name: create_access_request
tools.description: Create a Just-In-Time access request for a privileged Account -- for Safes configured with dual control, this must be confirmed before retrieval succeeds.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

reason.description: Business reason for requesting access -- required by CyberArk for the audit trail.
reason.title: Reason

multiple_access.description: Whether this request permits multiple retrievals instead of a single one.
multiple_access.title: Multiple Access

access_from.description: ISO 8601 start time for the access window (optional).
access_from.title: Access From

access_to.description: ISO 8601 end time for the access window (optional).
access_to.title: Access To

tools.name: list_access_requests
tools.description: List Just-In-Time access requests for a privileged Account.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

account_id.description: CyberArk account ID to list access requests for.
account_id.title: Account Id

status_filter.description: Optional status filter: pending, confirmed, cancelled.
status_filter.title: Status Filter

tools.name: confirm_access_request
tools.description: Confirm a pending Just-In-Time access request on a dual-control Safe -- required from a second approver before the requestor can retrieve the credential.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: cancel_access_request
tools.description: Cancel a pending Just-In-Time access request before it is confirmed or used.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List AAM/CCP Application identities configured on the connected CyberArk vault -- the programmatic identities that can fetch credentials without a human.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Read one AAM/CCP Application identity in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List account-type Platforms (templates) configured on the connected CyberArk vault, e.g. 'WinServerLocal', 'UnixSSH' -- required when onboarding a new Account.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_security_events
tools.description: Read the Security Events audit trail for the connected CyberArk vault -- who accessed or changed what, and when.

connection_id.description: Optional saved CyberArk vault connection ID. Omit to use the first connected vault.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

search.description: Optional free-text filter (user, safe, or action).
search.title: Search

secrets.name: cyberark_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected CyberArk PVWA vaults and encrypted credentials. Managed only through connect_cyberark and disconnect_cyberark.
